states: Private stacks built from this tree: community runtime (7782/5282), community DEMO_MODE runtime (7783/5283) and a Pro runtime built from pulse-enterprise against this tree (7784/5284), mock data, dev-signed Pro and Enterprise licences. Playwright Chromium at 1280x900 dark and 390x844 light, plus the in-app browser pane.

Free community install (no licence, hideUpgrade true, hideCommercial false, ai_alerts absent, /api/settings/ai alert_triggered_analysis false via a real persisted save): switch disabled and off, card reads 'Higher license plan required. This install's plan does not include container update risk.' with no link; the switch's aria-describedby points at that line.

Unlicensed Pro runtime (prompts allowed, ai_alerts not granted, backend licence checker masks the setting to false): same plan-lock line plus a Plans & Billing link to /settings/pulse-intelligence/billing/plan.

Pro licence on the community runtime (ai_alerts blocked as paid_runtime_required): 'Pulse Pro runtime required. This install is running Pulse Community runtime. Install the Pulse Pro runtime to use container update risk.' plus Open Pro downloads (https://pulserelay.pro/download.html, new tab, noopener).

Hidden commercial surfaces via DEMO_MODE (hideCommercial and hideUpgrade true; read-only demo, so GET /api/settings/ai intercepted to alert_triggered_analysis false): 'Not available. This install does not include container update risk.' with no plan or Pro wording and no link.

Enterprise licence on the community runtime (white-label, hideCommercial true, ai_alerts runtime-blocked): runtime lock copy without the download link, which is the canonical runtime-before-commercial precedence shared with Patrol mode.

Pro licence on the Pro runtime: switch enabled, no lock line, no aria-describedby. No horizontal overflow and no page errors in any state; the disabled track styling is the pre-#2535 shared Toggle and is unchanged here.
interactions: Clicked the Plans & Billing link from the locked card in the browser pane; it routed in-app to /settings/pulse-intelligence/billing/plan.
On the licensed Pro runtime, turned the container update risk switch on and saved Patrol settings; GET /api/settings/ai then returned alert_triggered_analysis true.
Switched licence state live (activate Pro, activate Enterprise, clear) against the same backend and reloaded the page for each state.
